newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: HKB Managed Funds joining HSBC Asset Management.
newsitem.headline: HKB Managed Funds joining HSBC Asset Management.

text.p: HongkongBank of Australia said on Friday that its funds business, HKB Managed Funds, is being transferred to its dedicated and advisory arm, HSBC Asset Management Australia Limited.

The benefits of the transfer of the HKB High Yield Trust and HKB Money Market Trust to HSBC Asset Management's expert adminstration include providing the trust's clients with a range of services beyond cash management and fixed interest trusts, such as property and equity trusts, said Chris Crook, Chief Executive Officer and Country Head for HongkongBank of Australia.
The HKB Managed Funds trusts would be managed by HSBC Asset Management's special fxed interest and cash team comprising three experienced investment specialists.

The team, which conducts its own macro and microeconomic research as well as using the Group's global research resources, is overseen by HSBC Asset Management Australia's Managing Director, David Stevens and Chief Investment Officer for Australian equities, Stephen Babidge.

HSBC Asset Management manages more than A$55.9 billion on behalf of clients and in Australia it manages over A$5.4 billion in Funds including more than A$1.5 billion in fixed interest and cash investments.
